name: week
title: Complaints this week
subtitle: What needs a person, worst first. Read-only. Changes are made by asking Claude Code.

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select item, ref, brand, owner, detail, due_on as due from attention_queue order by rank, due_on, ref

sections.title: Responses due in the next 14 days
sections.sql: select ref, brand, complainant, owner, complaint_type as type, respond_by as due, days_left from open_complaints where days_left <= 14 order by respond_by, ref

name: deadlines
title: Every open complaint and its clock

sections.title: Open complaints
sections.sql: select ref, brand, complainant, owner, received_on as received, acknowledged_on as acknowledged, checkpoint_on as nz_checkpoint, respond_by as due, days_left, delay_notice_on as delay_notice, rule from open_complaints order by respond_by, ref
sections.note: Timeframes come from the idr_timeframes table: RG 271 Table 2 in Australia, the FSCL Terms of Reference in New Zealand.

name: board
title: Complaints for the board
subtitle: Systemic issues, rule checks and remedies.

sections.title: Systemic issues
sections.sql: select code, title, owner, status, raised_on as raised, reported_to, reported_on, complaints, open_complaints from systemic_register order by status, raised_on

sections.title: Rule checks
sections.sql: select severity, rule, ref, brand, finding from compliance_findings order by case severity when 'breach' then 0 else 1 end, rule, ref

sections.title: Complaints and remedies by product
sections.sql: select product, currency, count(*) as complaints, count(*) filter (where status = 'open') as open, to_char(coalesce(sum(remedy_cents), 0) / 100.0, 'FM999,999,990.00') as remedies from complaint_register group by product, currency order by complaints desc, product
